# What the plugin SDK contains

Every header the plugin SDK installs under `<sdk>/include`, with the summary at the top of the header and the types it declares. Plugin API 1.3.0. The SDK also installs `cyxwiz-backend`'s import library, the CMake package `CyxWizSDK`, the template plugin and the Python example nodes; see [plugin-quickstart.md](plugin-quickstart.md). The SDK ships no ArrayFire, ImGui or spdlog headers: anything below that needs them (an `af::array` in a signature, a panel's ImGui calls) builds only inside the CyxWiz source tree.

## Plugin interface

| Header | What it is | Types |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin/plugin_types.h` |  | `PluginVersion`, `PluginDependency`, `PluginManifest`, `IPlugin`, `PluginPermission`, `PluginCapability`, `PluginState` |
| `plugin/plugin_context.h` |  | `AssistantContextSnapshot`, `PluginContext` |
| `plugin/plugin_fingerprint.h` | Build fingerprint of a plugin (TOFIX125 P5 step 5.1, Part D6, decision D4). A trainable plugin node is a real cyxwiz::Module: the plugin shares C++ objects with the Engine, so it must be built the way the Engine was (compiler family, standard library, build type, pointer size, SDK and ArrayFire... | `FingerprintDifference` |
| `plugin/interfaces/i_analytics_provider.h` |  | `AnalyticsResult`, `PluginAnalyticsInfo`, `IAnalyticsProvider` |
| `plugin/interfaces/i_assistant_provider.h` |  | `AssistantCommandRequest`, `AssistantCommandSection`, `AssistantCommandSource`, `AssistantCommandResponse`, `IAssistantProvider` |

| `plugin/interfaces/i_panel_provider.h` |  | `PluginPanelInfo`, `IPanelProvider` |
| `plugin/interfaces/i_tensor_node_provider.h` | Trainable extension nodes from a C++ plugin (TOFIX125 P2, plugin API 1.1). A plugin returns this from IPlugin::QueryInterface("ITensorNodeProvider"). Each node is one tensor in, one tensor out (a layer or an activation); its module is a real cyxwiz::Module, so it trains like a built-in layer.... | `TensorNodeInfo`, `Pin`, `Parameter`, `TensorNodeCallback`, `ITensorNodeProvider` |
| `plugin/interfaces/i_training_hook.h` |  | `TrainingContext`, `ITrainingHook` |
| `core/extension_node_contract.h` | Extension nodes (TOFIX125): node types CyxWiz does not ship, supplied by a C++ plugin or a Python node bundle. Every extension node is a NodeType::PluginCustom on the canvas; its identity is the string type id "<provider_id>:<TypeName>". The description reuses NodeMetadata so typed parameters... | `ExtensionVerification`, `ExtensionNodeDescriptor`, `ExtensionShapeResult`, `ITensorNodeFactory`, `ITensorLossFactory`, `ExtensionNodeKind`, `ExtensionLayerRole`, `ExtensionLossTarget`, `ExtensionSource`, `Status` |
| `core/node_metadata.h` |  | `PortDefinition`, `ParameterDefinition`, `SupportAxisDefinition`, `NodeMetadata`, `NodeImplementationStatus`, `ParameterConsumption`, `NodePropertiesEditor` |
| `core/graph_model.h` | The graph data model: node and pin types and the saved node/link records. GUI-free, so the training core (graph compiler, model builder, executors) can use it without the editor; gui/node_editor.h includes it (TOFIX118 P2). Numeric NodeType values are persisted in .cyxgraph files: append only. | `NodePin`, `MLNode`, `NodeLink`, `SubgraphData`, `NodeCategory`, `NodeType`, `PinType`, `LinkType` |
